title: Autonomous Incident Resolution at Hyperscale: An Agentic AI Architecture for Network Operations
title_zh: 超大规模环境下的自治故障处置：面向网络运维的 Agentic AI 架构
abstract_en: Cloud network infrastructure at hyperscale presents unique operational challenges where traditional human-driven incident response cannot keep pace with the volume, velocity, and complexity of failures. This paper presents an agentic AI architecture for autonomous incident resolution in large-scale network operations. Our system employs a multi-agent orchestration framework where specialized AI agents collaborate to detect, diagnose, and remediate network incidents without human intervention. We describe the architectural principles, including hierarchical agent decomposition, skills-based tool invocation via standardized protocols, structured knowledge encoding from operational runbooks, progressive autonomy with safety boundaries, and closed-loop verification. The architecture has been deployed in production at a major cloud provider, demonstrating that agentic AI systems can achieve autonomous resolution rates exceeding 90% for common incident categories while maintaining safety guarantees through layered authorization and rollback mechanisms. We discuss design tradeoffs, failure modes, and lessons learned from operating autonomous AI agents at scale.
abstract_zh: 本文面向超大规模云网络基础设施中的故障响应难题，提出一种用于大规模网络运维自治故障处置的 Agentic AI 架构。该系统采用多智能体编排框架，由多个专门化 AI agents 协同完成网络事件的检测、诊断与修复，并尽量减少人工介入。论文重点介绍了其架构原则，包括层级化智能体分解、基于技能的工具调用与标准化协议、从运维 runbooks 中进行结构化知识编码、带安全边界的渐进式自治，以及闭环验证机制。该架构已在某大型云服务提供商的生产环境部署，在常见故障类别上实现超过 90% 的自治解决率，同时通过分层授权与回滚机制维持安全保障。论文还讨论了系统设计取舍、失效模式，以及大规模运行自治 AI agents 的实践经验。
key_points_zh: 提出面向 hyperscale 云网络运维的 Agentic AI 架构，用于自治检测、诊断和修复网络 incident。
采用 multi-agent orchestration，将复杂故障处置拆解为层级化、专门化 agents 协作流程。
通过 runbooks 结构化编码、skills-based tool invocation 和标准化协议，使 agents 能可靠调用运维工具。
引入 progressive autonomy、安全边界、分层授权、回滚机制和 closed-loop verification，降低自治操作风险。
生产部署结果显示，系统在常见 incident 类别上自治解决率超过 90%，并总结了规模化运行中的设计取舍与失效模式。

llm_assessment.comment: A highly valuable production agent architecture with orchestration, skill invocation, safety boundaries, rollback, and closed-loop verification at hyperscale.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该文展示了超大规模生产级代理架构，涵盖编排、技能调用、安全边界、回滚和闭环验证，价值很高。
